cohort: 47 twin pregnancies with preterm labor of the first fetus between 20-30 weeks, and delayed delivery of the second twin
finding: Delayed second twin delivery was associated with increased gestational age at delivery, birth weight, and survival rate for the second twin.
gest_age: First twin: 22.6 +/- 3.4 weeks, Second twin: 34.3 +/- 2.5 weeks
birth_weight: First twin: 435 +/- 91.2 g, Second twin: 1472 +/- 61.5 g
